page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 166 left and title right. Main text in one column, with a narrow column of marginal notes at the left. Below the text, a catchword line at the foot ("tas" at the right of the bottom rule, with a faint word at left).

main_text.p: deuoti clientes se vnanimiter commendent, profternantq; non celeritas naturæ (vt Hieronymus) sed vera vbiquitas, vt fatetur Bellarminus, iftic, ad preces hafce percipiendas, requireretur: Quid nunc obstat, quo minus qui sanctorum animas in Diuos, Diuorum spiritus in Deos aliquando transmutent? Deinde vero, quis Prophetarum, quis Apostolorum iuffit? quis fecit Sanctorum prisci ævi? aut quid denique aliud (si qua Theodoreto fides) sub θρησκεία τῶν ἀγγέλων Coloffensibus suis interdixit Paulus? aut quæ Collyridianorum hæresis fuit, si hæc pietas

page.notes: <note side="left">Lib.1. contr. Vigil.</note> <note side="left">Bell.l.1. de Beat. sanct. c.20.</note> Faint show-through of the facing page is not transcribed. The Greek phrase in the text is transcribed as best it can be read; the accents may be imperfect. The word "vnanimiter" is printed as "vnanimiter" with a worn letter (possibly "ʋ" or "u") and "qua" in "sed qua Theodoreto" is printed with a blot obscuring a letter.
